name: learning-coach
description: Learn, inspect, and maintain a private GitHub-backed learning state with auditable mastery evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Build and maintain a private knowledge tree that grows with you
interface.longDescription: Learn through practice, diagnose gaps and assumptions, track auditable mastery evidence, and periodically review or refactor a private GitHub-backed Learning Vault.
defaultPrompt: Help me master agent memory and resume from my Learning Vault.
Review what I am most likely to forget next.
Show my current learning gaps, assumptions, and the evidence behind them.
Review my Learning Vault for structural issues and propose safe refactors.
